item.title: AHSAA reclassifies high school athletics for public and private schools
item.description: MONTGOMERY, Ala. (WIAT) -- The Alabama High School Athletic Association voted to reclassify public and private schools for championship play. Public and private high school athletes will now compete for their own championship titles. item.title: New law could ban old reading instruction in Alabama elementary schools
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) — One bill sponsored by a local legislator aims to improve reading instruction in Alabama. The bill, sponsored by Senator Donnie Chasteen (R-Geneva), bans the "three-cueing" reading teaching method. The three-cueing method was once popular but is now considered ineffective.
